name: EPIC 211082656
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 11.1 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,336 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.80 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,894 K at its surface.
